steps.title: وَ, لَكِنْ, and لَيْسَ
body: A slightly longer text joins two short ideas. وَ ("and") attaches to the next word: وَالْأُمُّ. لَكِنْ means "but".
لَيْسَ turns a sentence negative and puts the comment in the -an form: لَيْسَ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدًا = "the weather is not cold."
Read each half on its own, then put them together.

steps.title: Four longer sentences
steps.intro: Each one has two parts. Read the first part, then the joining word, then the second part.

steps.title: Comprehension
steps.arabicPrompt: الْأَبُ فِي الْمَكْتَبِ وَالْأُمُّ فِي الْبَيْتِ
steps.explanation: The second half — وَالْأُمُّ فِي الْبَيْتِ — says the mother is فِي الْبَيْتِ, at home.

steps.title: Two ideas, one sentence
steps.message: You read four sentences that join two ideas with وَ, لَكِنْ, or لَيْسَ. Practise them in Review.
